description: Use this when the user picks a place from find_places or asks to tell more about it: pass slug = the last part of that place's url (or the whole url). Returns the full details of one Aventuro place: name, category, city, country, coordinates, a link to the place page, the popularity score, the typical time visitors spend there in minutes (visit_minutes, not the time to see everything) and the whole stored travel description (facts, tips, best time, etiquette and more), plus up to 3 verified photos with author and licence credits (images, may be empty). Write the place name as a markdown link [name](url) when url is present and show the url as the source link. When images are present, show each images[].url as a markdown image with its author credit. attributes gives the five needs as true (known yes) or null (unknown, never a no); matched_needs, matched_tastes and matched_tags are always empty here. setting and parking follow the same true-or-null rule. content_status is no_description when no travel description is stored; fallback_reason is translation_unavailable when lang differs from the requested one.

detail.description: full (default): the whole stored description. brief: summary and top tips.

lang.description: Language of the name and description. Falls back to English.

slug.description: The place: the last part of a find_places url (e.g. "old-fortress"), or that whole url.

name: get_place
title: Get place details
